title: Celestia: free SpaceEngine alternative
caption:
SpaceEngine charges $29.99 to fly around the universe. Celestia does it for free 🌌

✅ Fly to any planet, moon, spacecraft or one of 100,000+ stars
✅ Zoom from a tiny spacecraft out to galaxy clusters
✅ Speed up time and watch the planets move
✅ Expandable with free add-ons, no purchase needed

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ The desktop app is completely free. The Celestia mobile apps for iPhone and Android are free to download but offer an optional paid Celestia PLUS subscription

Comment "GALAXY" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
